newsitem.title: USA: Virgin Express might buy Boeing jets - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Virgin Express might buy Boeing jets - WSJ.

text.p: No-frills airline Virgin Express is talking with Boeing Co about buying 25 737-700 jets worth as much as $1.1 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.
The newspaper said Virgin was also talking about expanding it fleet with Airbus Industrie and McDonnell Douglas Corp.
"(But) clearly Boeing is the leading contender," Jonathan Ornstein, Virgin Express's chief executive officer, was quoted as saying in an interview with the Journal.
Ornstein said the airline was also looking at ways to cooperate with Belgian carrier Sabena in fuelling, ground operations and catering.
Virgin might also consider leasing used aircrafts since the market was become cheaper, he added.
